title: The Courtyard of Windows
survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 5 (Exit 5/5 Dead End; Environment 4/5 Extreme Environmental Risk; Entities 5/5 Hostile Infestation)
physical_identity: A cold, silent white-concrete indoor atrium ringed by evenly spaced windows infested with window entities, with a central pentagonal path, hollow birchwood circle, table, gramophone and clock.
scale_topology: Irregular atrium ~45 m wide and ~30 m high; unstable white corridors on several floors reached by mahogany doors; walkways above.
lighting_sound: Corridors harshly lit white; atrium silent; gramophone music in logs; 13.8 C and 45.2% humidity constant.

entities.name: Window entities (Entity 2)
entities.behavior: Infest atrium windows; shadowy window-like silhouettes in corridors

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: window entities, pink dress facelings, skin-stealers, shadow silhouettes
hazards: neuro agents (table, clock, gramophone, wood circle, railings)
items_communities: table, gramophone, old photographs, books, vases, alarm clock
living moss given to Amor Incrementum

entrances.method: a window that vanishes after 2-3 minutes
entrances.quote: Windows leading into Level 188 have been found on a variety of indoor levels.

exits.method: leave through the entry window immediately
exits.quote: leave immediately through the window from which you entered
vacant windows are believed to lead to Level 1.5

signature_mechanic: A trap atrium whose entry window vanishes and whose fixtures and windows shift while the player resists neuro-agent objects in near silence.
verticality: Corridor wing spans several floors with stairwells and walkways overlooking the atrium; atrium 30 m tall.
do_not: add working exits via windows or wooden circle
add loud music except gramophone logs
treat corrupted Gatsby text as fact
conflicts_notes: Author attribution: cite-as says Kai4C; body says original author 1000dumplings, rewritten by Kai4C. Log 1 'space station' link points back to /level-188. Logs 4 and 5 headed 'BUCHANAN LOG' and 'WEST EGG' (corrupted).

key_quotes.quote: Do not enter the Courtyard of Windows.
It is not a trapdoor. It is not an exit.
There are no settlements or communities on this level.
